subject: general
question: Which of the following famous Indian athletes won the Zurich Diamond League final 2022 in September 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Neeraj Chopra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Neeraj Chopra** is an Indian track and field athlete who competes in the javelin throw.
 
• He created history by becoming the first Indian to win a gold medal in athletics at the **Olympic Games** when he won the men's javelin throw at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics.
 
• On 8th September 2022, Neeraj Chopra became the first Indian to win the Zurich Diamond League final with a throw of 88.44 meters.
 
• He has consistently performed well in international competitions, bringing laurels to India in the field of athletics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** 

 
• **Zurich Diamond League**

 
 
• The Diamond League is an annual series of elite track and field athletic competitions comprising fourteen of the best invitational athletics meetings.
 
• It was founded in 2010, and the Zurich meeting is one of the most prestigious events in this series.
 
• Athletes accumulate points at each Diamond League meet and the top performers in each event compete in the final, where the winner is crowned the Diamond League champion.
 
 
 
• **Javelin Throw**
 
 
• Javelin throw is a track and field event where the javelin, a spear about 2.5 meters in length, is thrown.
 
• The objective is to throw the javelin as far as possible; the athlete with the longest valid throw wins.
 
• It has been a part of the modern Olympic Games since its inception for men in 1908 and for women in 1932.
 
 
 
• **Neeraj Chopra's Career Highlights**
 
 
• Neeraj Chopra won the gold medal at the 2018 Commonwealth Games and the 2018 Asian Games, where he also set a new Indian national record.
 
• He made his mark internationally by becoming the World Junior Champion in 2016.
 
• He is also the first Indian to win a Diamond League title, which he achieved in August 2022 in Lausanne before winning the Zurich final.
